seo.title: Free Email & SMS Audit | BAD Marketing
seo.description: Find the revenue your list is leaving on the table.

props.text: 🔥 We only run 10 free audits per week.

props.headline: Your Email List Is Sitting On Money. Let's Go Get It.
props.sub: Get a free, no-fluff Email & SMS teardown from the team behind brands doing $1B+ a year. We'll show you exactly which flows, segments and campaigns are leaking revenue.
props.bullets:
Flow-by-flow revenue gap analysis
Segmentation & deliverability check
SMS opportunity estimate in dollars
A 30-day action plan you keep either way

props.headline: Real Retention Wins
props.items:
+58.9% | Email revenue | Flow rebuild + segmentation overhaul
+47.78% | SMS revenue | New welcome, browse & winback SMS
+20% | Email revenue | Campaign calendar + creative refresh

props.headline: If Email Is Under 30% Of Your Revenue, Something's Broken
props.body: Here's what we find in almost every account we audit:
props.items:
Welcome flow is 3 emails when it should be 9
Abandoned cart hasn't been touched since launch
Everyone gets the same campaign, every time
SMS is either missing or blasting discounts

props.headline: What's Inside Your Free Audit
props.items:
Full Klaviyo / Attentive / Postscript account teardown | $1,500
Flow revenue gap model (in dollars) | $750
Deliverability & list health report | $500
30-day retention action plan | $750

Work email | email | email

Email/SMS platform | select | esp | Klaviyo, Attentive, Postscript, Omnisend, Other / None
props.consent: By submitting, you agree to receive calls and texts (including automated) from us at the number provided. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.

props.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
props.items:
Is it really free? | Yes. We do it because a good audit is the best sales pitch there is.
Who does the audit? | A senior retention strategist, not a bot or an intern.
Do you need access to my account? | View-only access gives a deeper audit, but we can start from your public flows.
What if I already have an agency? | Great. Use the audit to hold them accountable.
